cat > /tmp/check.py <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, cv2, sys
d=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1],index_col=0); o=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv',index_col=0)
img=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); H,W=img.shape[:2]
cnt=np.zeros((H,W),int); vis=img.copy()
print(list(d.columns)==list(o.columns), len(d)==len(o))
for (i,r),(_,r0) in zip(d.iterrows(),o.iterrows()):
    xs=np.array(r.coords_x.split(','),int); ys=np.array(r.coords_y.split(','),int)
    pts=np.stack([xs,ys],1)
    m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m,[pts],1)
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m)
    assert n==2, (i,n)
    assert r.xmin==xs.min() and r.xmax==xs.max() and r.ymin==ys.min() and r.ymax==ys.max()
    if len(set(zip(xs,ys)))<=4: print('few pts',i,r0.type)
    cnt+=m
    cv2.polylines(vis,[pts],True,(0,255,0),1)
    x0=np.array(r0.coords_x.split(','),int);y0=np.array(r0.coords_y.split(','),int)
    cv2.polylines(vis,[np.stack([x0,y0],1)],True,(0,0,255) if r0.type=='rectangle' else (255,0,0),1)
print('max overlap',cnt.max())
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/vis.png',cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2.5,fy=2.5,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST))
EOF
python /tmp/check.py /tmp/out1/demo_metadata.csv
